sourceTruth: Judge faithful representation of what the narrative says, not historical truth or legal liability.

taskScope.required: Preserve all explicit parking-relevant claims, their negation/modality/roles/time/episode/source layers; retain unresolved conflicts; indicate genuinely missing inputs for the declared next step.
taskScope.taskDefinedGapPolicy: Followups are candidate clarification targets for this pilot, not a statutory checklist or a claim of normative sufficiency. Apply requiredWhen; do not require irrelevant followups for known unsupported scope. Semantic equivalent specific questions are allowed.
taskScope.outside: Legal outcome/fine, procedural advice, full legal ontology and verification of primary publications.
taskScope.multiEpisode: Keep both episodes; ask user to select before single-episode qualification.
taskScope.claimantPolicy: Narrator, defender, personal note, bank/app, notice and other sources remain distinct. Source statements are not automatically real-world findings.
taskScope.identityPolicy: Do not infer a personal vehicle, driver=owner, narrator disability, or vehicle identity from null/missing values.

criticalErrors.example: Не утверждаю, что оплатил becomes оплатил or не оплатил.
Infer Moscow from fine amount or page theme.

criticalErrors.error: Wrong actor, claimant, vehicle, episode, date or payment object
criticalErrors.example: Fine payment becomes parking-session payment; notice date becomes event date.

criticalErrors.error: Conflicting sources collapsed or one erased
criticalErrors.example: Notice of nonpayment overrides narrator assertion without preserved attribution.

criticalErrors.error: Missing/unknown/ambiguous converted into affirmative or negative fact
criticalErrors.example: No information about a sign becomes sign absent.

criticalErrors.error: Material explicit parking claim omitted across the whole source
criticalErrors.example: Both morning paid and evening unpaid must survive extraction.

criticalErrors.error: Required clarification for the declared next step silently filled or omitted
criticalErrors.example: Choose an episode automatically or assume a tariff for the event interval.

criticalErrors.error: Unsupported domain treated as supported, or unsupported used to erase source facts
criticalErrors.example: Kazan is silently changed to Moscow; free standing is silently called paid.

nonCritical: Wording or ordering differences that preserve relations and scope.
Different schema layout, provided it can represent the required distinctions.
Wide but valid source anchor; review precision may be tracked separately.
reviewOrder: Keep original automatic output immutable; record operational status before semantics.
Review every source statement against output and every output claim against source; never check only supplied probes.
Check selected episode, quote support, polarity/modality, roles/source layers and uncertainty.
Check coverage, unsupported scope and applicable task-defined followups.
Record each error with source span and output location; preserve alternative readings and disagreements.
Save candidate/human/adjudicated decisions separately; no full quality score until outputs receive whole-case review.
qualityDenominator: All assigned original texts; failures stay in operational denominator. Repeats and derived probes do not add cases.
qualityReporting: No overall case quality rate is computed by this packet. Candidate agreement is separate; human review count is zero.
representationBoundary: If output cannot express attribution, episode, gap or unknown distinction, record contract limitation separately; do not force a lossy label to match.
